## Checklist

- [ ] The pack was built in Cairn and exported as `.learnpack`.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally.
- [ ] The pack has a licence and I have the right to share its content.
- [ ] The pack contains no executable code, scripts, or free-form system prompts.
- [ ] Labs are learner-run text and do not execute on the host.
- [ ] Hints at level 1 do not reveal answers.
- [ ] I have read [POLICY.md](../POLICY.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
